edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTION. Defendant objects to production of material protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or other applicable protection. This objection applies only to material for which protection is claimed; it does not excuse production of otherwise responsive, non-privileged material.

2. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES AND PRODUCTION. Defendant will provide a separate response to each numbered request identifying any objection and its scope, stating whether responsive material is being withheld on that basis, and identifying the responsive, non-privileged documents it will produce from its possession, custody, or control. A production date will be confirmed with those responses.
3. PRIVILEGE LOG. With its production, Defendant will provide a privilege log for responsive documents withheld on privilege grounds, to the extent a log is required by applicable rules or agreement.

delivered.body: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production. 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged material. 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to the foregoing objection, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control. 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Defendant will identify on a privilege log any responsive documents withheld on privilege grounds. 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement this response.
